free_tier_limits: New AWS customers get up to $200 in AWS Free Tier credits for six months. The SES-specific 3,000 message-charges/month offer ended for new customers July 21, 2026; existing participants retain it for the remainder of their 12-month term.
example_request: curl --request POST 'https://email.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v2/email/outbound-emails' --aws-sigv4 'aws:amz:us-east-1:ses' --user "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}:${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}" --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"FromEmailAddress":"verified-sender@example.com","Destination":{"ToAddresses":["recipient@example.com"]},"Content":{"Simple":{"Subject":{"Data":"Hello","Charset":"UTF-8"},"Body":{"Text":{"Data":"Test from Amazon SES","Charset":"UTF-8"}}}}}'
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: corrected; AWS ended the SES-specific offer for new customers on July 21, 2026. Evidence: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/messaging-and-targeting/introducing-amazon-simple-email-service-ses-pricing-plans/ example: corrected; SES v2 uses a SigV4-signed POST to /v2/email/outbound-emails and returns MessageId.
